lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Sparse array of approximately 5-7 high-luminance circular pixel clusters visible along the far-left lateral margin, exhibiting a predominantly vertical orientation.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal Echeneidae) attached to the ventral midline and posterior margins of the pectoral fins.
